items.title: The action of PSL_2(Z) on the algebra Lambda is faithful
items.author: Paul Terwilliger
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the action of PSL_2(Z) on the algebra Lambda is faithful (statement lines 834-838). The proof argues by contradiction on a central word: after writing the word in the alternating form eta_1...eta_n and letting ell be the number of occurrences of s, it reads the word as a polynomial in lambda with 2x2 matrix coefficients, shows the top coefficient is nonzero by the two relations s_1 p s_1 = -s_1 and s_1 p^{-1} s_1 = s_1, and then compares degrees: centrality forces eta = kappa I, determinants force ell even and kappa = +- lambda^{ell/2}, so the polynomial would have degree ell/2 rather than ell (proof lines 841-910). The decisive step is the degree comparison, which needs both the explicit top coefficient and the determinant identity; both are computed inside the span. H2.
